ops.title: Partition native stack reads by the requested forest before validating trunks
ops.description: Two standalone dev callers were refused by an unrelated native catalog entry: "native stacks target multiple trunks (dar-p8a-step7-list-n, dev); the shared stack planner requires one common trunk". Affected callers: /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/monorepo/yasyf-trunk-auto-reporter (10 staged files, no PR) and yasyf-native-async-bypass-body-true. The root authorized an explicit --no-stack workaround for the Go caller; this task must preserve caller work and the shared catalog. Select the requested/current native forest and its trunk before enforcing the shared planner single-trunk invariant. Requested plans spanning real distinct roots must still refuse.

ops.text: A native dev caller ignores an unrelated stack with another trunk.
Explicit plans requesting forests with different trunks still refuse before mutation.
Untracked branches select an explicit parent or designated default without changing unrelated catalog entries.
